The schema declares another dialect than draft 2020-12 as its $schema.
The schema references a schema of an older draft, and the test expects that schema to be read as its own draft.
The schema does not resolve when it stands on its own: it references a document by a URL other than the $id that the document gives itself, and an embedded document is known by its $id only.

The expected results hold only where dependencies still works. Draft 2020-12 replaced it by dependentRequired and dependentSchemas, so under draft 2020-12 it is an unknown keyword that asserts nothing.
With format asserted, draft 2020-12 does not say what an unknown format accepts, and an implementation may refuse the schema. The expected results are those of format as an annotation.
The test case tells numbers apart by digits that a double does not hold, and the corpus writes numbers as doubles.
